Hi Sara / Michael —

Thanks again for the productive eval week. Per our MAP review, I want to lock the final go/no-go and the eSign window so we can commit an operational start date. Proposed cadence below: 

- Aug 10 (COB PT): any final redlines to the SOW or MAP deliverables sent to me (we’ve attached the latest MAP_v3 and SOW draft).
- Aug 11 (EOD PT): Redwood legal and OptiComm legal sign off on redlines; internal approvals continue.
- Aug 12 (09:00–17:00 PT): DocuSign envelope open — target for signatures.
- Aug 13: Purchase order / billing paperwork issued by OptiComm procurement (if signatures complete).
- Aug 16: Engineering kickoff (first day) and production ramp planning.

Can you confirm the above timeline from your side and flag any blockers (CFO approval, procurement gating, or additional evidence needed for security)? If the timeline looks good, I’ll have Camila finalize the SOW with the small liability tweak you mentioned and Ben will coordinate DocuSign + billing requirements.
